notes.title: Demo 0.0.4 Online
notes.content:
1. Now you can build wall! Press B to enter the construction mode.
2. The zombie path finding system is updated to support dynamic path calculation and they will try to bypass the wall.
3. Zombies can now climb over the fence! Shit!
4. When the zombies are hit by a small caliber bullet or hit by a car, if they are slightly injured, they have a chance to revive!
5. Upgrade the resolution of soldier texture to 8K.
6. Add the reload action. Now the assault rifle needs to be reloaded. A magazine has 30 rounds of bullets.
7. When controlling soldiers, scroll the wheel to zoom the field of view.
8. Continue to scroll the wheel to switch to the third-person view, suitable for screenshots.
9. Now the vehicle will be reacted when it hits a zombie or runs over a corpse!
10. Add a fog system.
Fixed:
1. Reduce the sound noise of gun shooting caused by high CPU overhead.
2. Fix the problem of inaccurate position of transparent shader caused by camera zooming after post-processing is turned off.
